title: Jarvis Session Context + Recording Runtime
summary: Make Jarvis Sessions survive runtime restarts until the user explicitly starts a new Session; add one active free-form Context with dormant history; add a canonical artifact/activity layer and Brain-independent audio transcription, screenshot and screen-recording capabilities; expose them through API/MCP and the existing floating left Control Center tool palette.
non_goals: Remove or redesign the existing Board subsystem wholesale
Redesign PRESENTATION or REUNION interaction modes
Treat ambient room speech as addressed Jarvis turns or authorization
Persist long media blobs inside SQLite
Reuse diagnostic scene-capture 24-hour retention as user capture storage
Force one universal document schema inside every Context
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary must be resolved in Slice 00; do not invent or default Task Types.
